name: librecad-mcp
description: Work LibreCAD with an AI: open, draw, inspect, measure, render and save 2D CAD drawings (DXF/DWG), live in the LibreCAD window.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a real, running LibreCAD (the LibreCAD-mcp build, which adds a token-protected Remote API that listens on this computer only). Open DXF and DWG files, draw lines, arcs, polylines, text, dimensions and hatches, manage layers, query and measure geometry, look at the drawing as an image, undo, and save or export to DXF/DWG (any version up to AutoCAD 2018-2026), PDF, PNG or SVG. Every change happens in the open LibreCAD window, where you see it at once. Closing without saving, deleting a layer and overwriting a file ask you first. Your drawings stay on your machine; the AI model comes from your MCP client, and your conversation goes wherever that client sends it.

Requires: (1) the LibreCAD-mcp build from https://github.com/ShiftSad/LibreCAD-mcp with Options > Application Preferences > Remote API (MCP) > Enable ticked; this extension then finds LibreCAD and its token by itself, and (2) uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), which supplies the uvx command this extension uses to run the server it carries (uv downloads the server's Python dependencies on the first start).

api_token.title: Remote API token (usually leave blank)
api_token.description: Leave blank: the extension reads the token from the file LibreCAD writes while its Remote API is enabled. Only set it if LibreCAD runs under another user account; copy it from Options > Application Preferences > Remote API (MCP).

api_url.title: LibreCAD Remote API address (usually leave blank)
api_url.description: Leave blank to use the address LibreCAD announces (http://127.0.0.1:13140 by default).

allowed_roots.title: Allowed folders (optional)
allowed_roots.description: Leave blank to allow any local folder. Otherwise the only folders the assistant may open files from or write files to, separated by ; on Windows and : on macOS and Linux. LibreCAD's own Preferences can restrict folders too.
